stage1.impression: A flat dark-brown slab, cropped at the top and filling half the frame, stands in a clear block on a busy limestone floor. The block's lower face melts into the floor, and the curved silver tab reads as a matte grey sticker, not a mirror. Nothing here looks like a $1,000 object.

blocking_9: The stamper shard must read as a mirror of grooves: a bright specular streak and a dark flag reflection across it, lum_range over the shard >= 120 (now 29, values 148-177, mottled like the marble it mirrors)
The sleeve must have tonal modelling: a soft sheen gradient of 25-60 levels across its face, and a neutral black (now 31 flat with a range of 4.4, warm cast r38/g31/b20)
The stand's base must separate from the floor: a dark edge line at its foot (now no step, 177-179 from the lower front band into the floor)
The floor must not have a hard-edged hot reflection: the upper-right wedge reads 239.5 median with 1.3% clipped, against a 210 floor
Contact shadow: the floor right under the stand is 180 against 185 a few cm away, so the stand floats

changes.problem: From a camera at z 660 the shard, leaning back 10 degrees, reflects a ray that heads down toward the floor just in front of the stand (computed direction about (430, -886, -300)), so it mirrors mottled marble and never sees the strip at z 130.

evidence.measured: lum_median 161.9, p5 148.4, p95 177.3, range 28.9; the 3x crop shows marble grain and no specular stripe; edge step at the shard rim is only 9.8 levels

changes.expected: The reflected ray rises to about +0.06 slope toward (430, -900, 130), so the shard carries the strip as a bright curved streak against the black flag behind it; the shard's lum range exceeds 120, with p95 above 225 and p5 below 70

changes.problem: Once the shard sees the strip, a 0.35 W/m2 strip will mirror at only the marble's level and will not pop as polished nickel.

evidence.measured: the brightest shard pixels p95 177.3, below the floor's 215 median; no highlight on the 'mirror' brighter than its surroundings

changes.expected: The strip's streak on the shard reads 230-250 without a broad clipped area, the brightest thing in the frame at its scale

changes.problem: The black sleeve is one value with no sheen, so it reads as a cut-out card and takes half the frame as dead mass.

evidence.measured: lum_median 31.6, p5 29.4, p95 33.8 (range 4.4); y-profile 32.6 to 25.7 over 550 px, x-profile 28.8 to 33.9; colour r38 g31 b20, warm rather than neutral

change.to: white card 1400 x 500 mm at (-900, -300, 900), turned to the sleeve's centre (0, 0, 250), unseen by the camera, matte white 0.8

changes.expected: The sleeve's board shows a soft diagonal sheen from upper left, falling 30-50 levels to the lower right; peak no higher than 90 so it stays black

changes.problem: The stand's lower front band is the floor's value, so the acrylic's bottom edge vanishes; clear acrylic needs dark refracted lines to draw its edges.

evidence.measured: y-profile 177.9, 177.9, 177.2, 175.2, 178.2, 176.7, 179.3, 176.9; largest step -4.5 levels, 50 px wide, across the stand-to-floor edge

change.to: matte black flag 900 x 120 mm, lying on edge at (0, -450, 100), turned to the stand, unseen by the camera

changes.expected: A dark refracted line of 60-110 along the foot and the lower edges of the block, a step of at least 50 levels from the floor

changes.problem: A hard-edged hot wedge in the floor at upper right (the bright sweep mirrored in the marble) pulls the eye off the product and clips.

evidence.measured: lum_median 239.5, p95 245.5, clip 1.3%, against 209-215 on open floor; the sweep at top left reads 240.7

changes.expected: The wedge spreads into a soft gradient peaking at or below 230 with no clipping and no straight edge

changes.problem: The fill flattens the floor around the stand, so the block casts no contact shadow and floats.

evidence.measured: lum_median 179.7 right under the stand, against 185.1 in [600, 1050, 1200, 1150]: a 5-level difference

changes.expected: A contact darkening of 20-40 levels in the first 10 mm of floor around the base, softening outward; the floor away from the stand stays between 185 and 215

changes.problem: The sweep at top left sits near clip, so the background competes with the floor and the stand's clear top for the brightest value.
changes.expected: The sweep reads 220-232, still light paper, a step below the shard's highlight

out_of_scope.request: Show the shard's grooves as visible concentric ridges
out_of_scope.why: Groove geometry and the stamper's surface are part of the object; the light (c1, c2) must reveal them, not a change to the shard

out_of_scope.request: Swap the busy marble for a quieter one
out_of_scope.why: The floor's veining competes with the clear block, but the marble is the house set; only its values and roughness were changed here (c5)
